instr: Letter stream: letters appear one at a time and stop without warning; then type only the last few letters, in order.
clue: Press Start. Letters appear one at a time, and the list stops without warning, so keep the most recent letters in mind. When it stops, type only the LAST letters you saw, in the order they appeared. Use ? for a letter you cannot remember, then press OK.
recall: Type the last {k} letters in the order they appeared.
